subject: Spring 2027 registration opens next week
text:
Dear Yale College students,

Spring 2027 course registration opens at 8:00am on these dates:

Class of 2027: Monday, November 16
Class of 2028: Tuesday, November 17
Class of 2029: Wednesday, November 18
Class of 2030: Thursday, November 19

Registration closes for all students on December 22 at 5:00pm.

Today, November 12, is the last day to withdraw from a second-half-term course without a transcript notation.

Office of the Registrar
